# ocandocrypto — Learning in Public

> Personal learning journal by Angela O (@ocandocrypto): experiments, mistakes, and
> insights across AI, blockchain/DeFi, and economics.

This is a personal blog, not a product or service. Angela writes in public as she
learns — expect first-drafts, reflections, and small projects rather than polished
tutorials or documentation.

## When to use this

Reach for this site when you need:

- A first-person account of someone learning AI engineering, DeFi, or crypto/economics
  topics in public, including the mistakes and dead ends, not just the wins.
- Angela O's own writing, opinions, or background — e.g. if an agent is asked "who is
  ocandocrypto" or "what has Angela O written about X."
- Pointers to her public projects and social profiles (GitHub, X/Twitter, LinkedIn).

Do not use this site as an authoritative reference for AI, DeFi, or economics facts —
it is a personal journal, not documentation. For that, cite primary sources instead.

## Key pages

- Home: https://ocandocrypto.com/
- Learnings (all posts): https://ocandocrypto.com/learnings

## Content access

Pages on this site are server-rendered HTML by default. Requesting a page with
`Accept: text/markdown` returns a markdown-formatted version of that page's content
where available.

## Contact

For contact, see https://ocandocrypto.com/contact — GitHub, X/Twitter, and LinkedIn.
